global.criterion: Compact sculpted premium educational 3D cartoon miniature matching S1-01 on warm off-white with plausible material textures, clean margins; not photojournalism, full outdoor photograph or toy-faced character.
No embedded words, numerals, arrows, fake text, product label, source school/Spark identity, brand, logo or watermark.
No people, hands, live release, actual corrosive chemical, dangerous exposure, rescue, neutralization, unapproved active cleanup or universal quantity threshold.

s103-video-prepare.criterion: Blank SDS/product-information holder and scenario cards, unused gloves, splash goggles, folded apron and closed simulated kit are separate dry inspection props; no active handling.
Picture does not show a specific respirator cartridge, product prescription or completed compatibility approval; exact suitability must remain conditional.
Close equipment-height tabletop composition differs clearly from prior split-site low decision scene and planned spatial reading map.

s103-video-response.criterion: Stable blank practice bottle, tiny harmless water patch completely bounded by absorbent perimeter, and separate closed mock-waste collection position are visually distinct in one sealed practice tray.
Drain-like channel is outside raised tray edge and has no depicted liquid or clean-up route into it.
No active person/hand, real chemical, actual treatment, neutralizer, hose, size-based permission or arbitrary cleaner is depicted.
Low side cutaway staging is not the planned overhead instructional cross-section or accepted decision-route scene.
